RSIFlow.changed_object: Diagnosed task component and reusable skill memory; released executable Meta is fixed.
RSIFlow.prefer_when: A heterogeneous workflow has observable component bottlenecks and skills with measurable applicability.
RSIFlow.risk: A task-specific successful intervention can become an unsupported universal memory entry.

Self-HPO.changed_object: Alternating H-step harness search and P-step reinforcement learning of policy weights.
Self-HPO.prefer_when: Training access and budget allow co-adapting weights and harness, with hard-task feedback between stages.
Self-HPO.risk: Changing both components confounds gains unless each is separately frozen and evaluated.

result.interpretation: Executable source/evidence audit of completed real trajectories. Existing flags and conditional memory illustrate routing and inheritance, not Self-HPO RL training or a faithful RSIFlow reproduction.
